learning_object: Accepted rubric, organization and execution experience; no parameter training or evaluator evolution.
primary_estimand: Task-level mean official-score difference between evolved and initial frozen experience states on identical test tasks.

state_policy.initial: Empty accepted experience store, identical fixed code/prompts/models/tools/retrieval policy.
state_policy.evolution_order:
Ascending SHA256('jit-compose-evolution-v1
' + run_id + '
' + task_id). All 30 evolution tasks once per run.
state_policy.proposal_selection: At most the first schema-valid reconciled proposal per evolution task, in returned order, with at most 8 validation attempts per run. No best-of selection using validation scores.
state_policy.terminal_state: After all 30 tasks and the fixed proposal budget; do not choose a checkpoint by test results.

validation_policy.blocks: Four consecutive blocks of five IDs in the frozen validation ordering.
validation_policy.schedule: Validation attempt k uses block (k modulo 4); at most 8 attempts. Pending/rejected attempts consume the schedule position and budget.
validation_policy.acceptance: Every pair complete and comparable; no per-repeat task regression or signed-direction criterion regression; average paired task improvement strictly greater than zero. Otherwise reject, or pending for incomplete/incomparable evidence.
validation_policy.rebuild: Both states independently predict requirements, plan, generate native JIT code, execute and evaluate; no plan/answer sharing or rewriting the source answer.
validation_policy.selection_bias: Repeated validation is adaptive selection, not a final generalization estimate or a fresh independent promotion audit. Log all exposure and rejected/pending proposals.

test_policy.release_feedback: After all prespecified test submissions and immutable state/config checks; no task-to-task test feedback.
test_policy.unit: Resample whole tasks retaining paired methods, execution repeats and evolved-state labels; separately report variation across the three independent evolution runs.

comparison_systems.status: pilot implementation only; not rubric-guided and not fixed-harness
not equivalent to current fixed_team_jit pilot; implementation required

proposed_model_configuration.provider_revision: UNVERIFIED; freeze serving identity and disclose proxy limitations before formal execution
proposed_model_configuration.model_seed_support: UNVERIFIED; split/order seeds do not imply deterministic API sampling
proposed_model_configuration.independent_judge_robustness: Additional model/configuration and blinded human-audit sample require preregistration before formal test feedback; not performed.

proposed_limits.notes: Common ceilings, not equal actual compute. Report stage-level actual usage and quality/cost. These are proposed formal limits, not a claim that the current pilot uses retrieval or these caps.

evidence_environment.primary_track: Source-enabled research generation with the same audited retrieval interface and pinned source-return policy for all methods.
evidence_environment.status: BLOCKED: retrieval/snapshot adapter and capability/containment audit not complete
evidence_environment.closed_book_pilot: Separate engineering diagnostic; do not substitute it for the source-enabled primary track or silently discard source-dependent tasks.
evidence_environment.time_sensitive_tasks: Document the task's requested time cutoff and snapshot policy before formal freeze; no post-score task removal.

failure_policy.incomplete_judge: Keep missing criterion and mark task incomplete; no available-criterion renormalization.
failure_policy.primary_mean: Only claim a complete paired official comparison if all prespecified paired evaluations are complete. Otherwise report incompleteness, completion rates and prespecified task-level score bounds; no favorable complete-case-only headline.
failure_policy.score_bounds: For binary criterion satisfaction use each task's official feasible lower bound sum(negative weights)/sum(positive weights) and upper bound 1; zero-positive-denominator tasks follow upstream handling and are flagged. Bounds are not fabricated official scores.
failure_policy.retry: No automatic whole-task retry. A documented infrastructure rerun requires a new run version for all affected paired methods; retain original failures and do not select best outcomes.

required_before_launch: Public topic/semantic-source overlap audit and time-cutoff review; candidate split is task-disjoint, not yet certified topic/source-disjoint.
Formal driver enforcing validation block rotation, proposal cap, independent repetitions, delayed test feedback and immutable snapshots; current pipeline defaults are insufficient.
Real retrieved-evidence adapter, deterministic snapshot semantics and generated-code isolation/capability boundary.
Pinned common code/prompts/config/reference archive and model/judge serving identity; no credentials in paper artifacts.
Complete baseline/control implementations and matching audit; unsupported controls remain unreported.
Independent judge/human audit policy plus multiplicity rules frozen before results.
Explicit launch request after preregistration; do not auto-start full benchmark or training from this draft.
notes: No formal experiment has been executed under this protocol. Pilot outputs and software tests must not populate the paper's main empirical table.
supersession_reason: Online paired-validation accept/hold/reject promotion was removed. This unrun draft and its task allocations are historical audit records only, not an active protocol. No replacement allocation is adopted.
